B: narrow opening with teeth nearly together for consonants and EE.
C: medium unrounded opening for EH and AE.

E: slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F: puckered rounded lips for UW, OW, and W.
G: upper teeth touching the lower lip for F and V.
H: tongue raised behind upper teeth for L, with an opening between C and D.
X: relaxed closed idle mouth.

Match each shape to its phoneme without arbitrary repetition or making all cells look alike. Keep the complete lower-half crop registered, with no independent mouth zoom or rescaling. Preserve source skin and all pixels outside the mouth naturally. No lipstick-red saturation, bright teeth flash, exaggerated grin, blur, gradients, vector smoothing, text, watermark, or added subjects.
